assumptions: Prototype assumption: landing performance and landing distance are suitable for the stated A350 test options.
Prototype assumption: a Code 4E aerodrome is not itself treated as proof of landing performance; approved EFB/FCOM performance verification remains a production requirement.
Scenario condition: stable one-engine-inoperative diversion case; no continuing fire, severe damage or additional system degradation is introduced.
QRH Rev 18 currency and aircraft effectivity must be reconciled against the operator's current controlled library before production use.

evidence.claim: SQ23 is planned KJFK-WSSS on 25.07.26 using A350-941 registration 9V-SGE.
ETP1-1D occurs at ACTM 03:18 near N56 26.2 W036 35.7, with CYQX and EINN shown as the EDTO diversion pair.

A350 in-flight landing performance following a diversion or failure is assessed with the approved EFB using factored in-flight landing distance; in an emergency, if the factor is disregarded, the in-flight landing distance must remain shorter than LDA.

For the training model, EDTO option discussion must retain estimated-time-of-use weather, diversion procedures, operational control and flight-dispatch considerations rather than treating distance alone as suitability.
Landing performance is treated as suitable for both test aerodromes in this vertical-slice fixture.
